# tealina

> Tealina turns a directory tree plus handler type annotations into routes, client types, and
> API documentation. The tree under `src/api/v1/` is the route table; the handler's type is
> the single source of truth. No framework is taken over: one mount line is the whole
> integration for Express, Fastify, or Koa.

## Start

- [README](./README.md): what the project is, how to scaffold, and the AI-assistant entry points.
- [Scaffold README](./packages/create-tealina/README.md): `create` and `init`, flags, and what a
  generated project contains.
- [AGENTS.md](./AGENTS.md): instructions for changing this repository, including the
  constraints that fail silently.
- [Generated project instructions](./packages/create-tealina/template/common/AGENTS.md): the
  same file a scaffolded project receives.

## Understand

- [Architecture](./docs/architecture.md): current design, subsystem by subsystem.
- [Architecture notes](./docs/architecture-notes.md): couplings, what not to change casually,
  and what CI does not cover.
- [History](./docs/history.md): dated decisions, only when you need the "why".

## Package READMEs

- [tealina](./packages/tealina/README.md): the CLI.
- [@tealina/server](./packages/tealina-server/README.md): `loadAPIs` and
  `transformToRouteOptions`.
- [@tealina/client](./packages/tealina-client/README.md): fetch and axios RPC clients.
- [@tealina/utility-types](./packages/utility-types/README.md): response wrappers and
  `MultiTarget`.
- [@tealina/doc-types](./packages/tealina-doc-types/README.md): the API document shape.
- [@tealina/doc-ui](./packages/tealina-doc-ui/README.md): serving the documentation site.
